plugins.name: agent-pipeline
plugins.description: Runs a vault ticket through test-first implementation, review and docs to a draft PR, with four subagents

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Turns a long, unstructured prompt into one structured prompt: it asks about points that conflict or are unclear, then runs the result only after you type go.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks haiku, sonnet or opus once per session from the first prompt and routes plain subagents to cheaper models

plugins.name: open-prs
plugins.description: A side pane listing the repo's open GitHub or Azure DevOps PRs with their review state, comment count and pipeline runs

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Writes a handoff file for the current session automatically on /handoff-session, shortly before the prompt cache goes cold, and when the context grows past a token threshold.

plugins.name: session-panel
plugins.description: A pane showing this session's connectors, skills, context files and to-do list, each in its own sub-panel

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: A side panel to switch each Claude Code mod and plugin on or off

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt showing usage for this chat, the 5h window and the week
